messages:
Emily Carter: Quick sync — planning coordinated version bumps across api / runtime / console / sdks. Target v1.12.0. Cutoff: Thu 14:00 PT. Plan to stagger to avoid CI/infrastructure spikes: runtime -> api -> console -> sdks. Owners: @Carlos, @Emily, @Mia, @Raj.
Raj Patel: SGTM. How long between each step? 10–15m or wait for promote? :thinking: 
Emily Carter: Prefer promote-based: merge runtime PR + CI green -> tag -> wait 30m for promote -> then api. If CI flakes, hold that lane. 
Carlos Gomez: I can own runtime. Will open one PR updating `version.go` + changelog. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/456 
Mia Huang: Console needs a tiny schema tweak — I'll branch off `release/v1.12.0` after api is tagged. ETA for my PR: Wed EOD. 
Raj Patel: SDKs need npm + pypi bumps. I'll prepare a single release PR to update `package.json` and `pyproject.toml`. Pinging @release-bot to create a release-notes stub. 
release-bot: Created release notes stub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/compare/v1.11.9...v1.12.0 
Emily Carter: Changelog owners: please add 1–2 bullets each under `# Changelog` and reference PRs. Keep bullets terse. 
Carlos Gomez: Added runtime bullets and noted the kernel perf tweak. PR updated. 
Raj Patel: I will also verify npm publish tokens are valid in CI. Reminder for SDKs: run `npm ci && npm run build` in release workflow. 
Mia Huang: Console e2e is ~12m. To avoid quota hits I'll set that workflow to `workflow_dispatch` and trigger manually during the stagger window. 
Emily Carter: Checklist before cutoff: 1) PRs open as draft, 2) changelog bullets present, 3) owners ready to flip PRs to ready/merge, 4) publish tokens checked. I'll post a 2h reminder. :thumbsup: 
Carlos Gomez: Tagging command for runtime (manual):
```
git tag -a v1.12.0 -m "runtime v1.12.0"
git push origin v1.12.0
```
Raj Patel: SDK bump flow (example):
```
npm version patch --no-git-tag-version
git commit -am "bump sdk v1.12.0"
git push
```
CI will handle tagging/publish step. 
Emily Carter: Thanks all — if anything blocks, reply here and we'll reorder. 
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled after api tag (auto).
